coder_notes: Only registered intervention is the EO2401 peptide vaccine (excluded type). Nivolumab and bevacizumab are named in arm descriptions/intervention text but not registered as separate interventions; listed for transparency. Nivolumab coded experimental_monotherapy (only non-excluded investigational agent, cf. pembrolizumab + vaccine example); in Cohort 1 it is added only after an initial vaccine-monotherapy phase. Bevacizumab (established GBM therapy, Cohort 3, US only) coded soc_backbone as background therapy; could alternatively be considered established_therapy_experiment. HLA-A2 positivity is a germline entry requirement and is not recorded as a tumour biomarker. Unmethylated MGMT is mentioned only as an allowance regarding prior temozolomide, not an entry requirement, so not recorded. Immunogenicity (CD8 T-cell response) relates to the vaccine, not to the candidate nivolumab, so target_engagement_planned = no. Arm text refers to 'EO2041' (apparent typo for EO2401).
